android.desc:
Notifian is a companion app for Obsidian that automatically schedules notifications for your notes. 

Features:
- Periodically scan your notes for reminders (as often as every 15 minutes)
- Allows you to view your upcoming reminders
- Show which vault each reminder belongs to (can scan up to 15 vaults)
- Automatically identifies reminders, recurring schedules and "stop on" properties in your Obsidian notes for notifications
- Automatically identifies reminders from the Obsidian "tasks" plugin (in both the "emoji" and "dataview" formats)
- Opens the related note in Obsidian when you click on a notification

NOTE: The Obsidian app must be active to sync notes (as of 24/12/24), so you should add reminder properties to notes ON MOBILE ONLY for the best experience. If you add those properties on desktop you'll need to open the Obsidian app and make sure they synced to your mobile device for the notifications to be created. 

* Notifian is not affiliated or sponsored by Dynalist Inc

quotes.text:
I'm an on and off Obsidian user who recently came back to Obsidian again. As flexible as the app is, one thing it can't do is set notifications on mobile devices. The feature seemed to be in demand on forums, reddit, etc but it's not on the Obsidian roadmap. So I figured I'd create a free app to set notifications from your Obsidian notes!

It's called Notifian and it's a "companion app" for the Obsidian Android app. It scans your Obsidian vault folder and identifies reminder properties in your notes to set:

- An initial reminder date/time

- (optional) A recurring schedule for reminders

- (optional) A "stop on" date/time, to stop scheduling reminders

It runs these scans in the background on a recurring interval and, as a bonus, it also has support for the Obsidian "tasks" plugin's task format!

The app just got out of closed testing and onto the play store, so I'd love to get more feedback on it now that it's released!
